subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should OpenClaw protect Feishu/direct DM session continuity by changing direct-session maintenance policy, Feishu peer-id validation/repair, or both?
rationale: The source-level problem is real enough to keep open, but the fix changes persisted session retention and possibly Feishu session-key migration behavior, which AGENTS.md treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Approve a bounded retention plus Feishu repair plan
options.body: Define TTL-aware direct-DM protection and a Feishu malformed-id detector or doctor repair before implementation.

options.title: Only document the workaround
options.body: Keep `per-account-channel-peer` and higher maintenance caps as the supported mitigation, accepting that malformed-id and stale-DM reports need fresh evidence.

options.title: Split policy decisions into separate issues
options.body: Move direct-DM retention and Feishu malformed-id migration into separate canonical issues so each can be designed and proven independently.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded retention plus Feishu repair plan
recommendation.body: Define TTL-aware direct-DM protection and a Feishu malformed-id detector or doctor repair before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the current blamed maintainer of the relevant session-maintenance, routing, and Feishu source surfaces on main.
